answer: Sybil resistance rests on a staked identity tied to work history. Each agent locks a refundable bond before submitting attestations, and a per-identity quota caps how much credit one key can mint, so a swarm of fresh keys gains nothing from volume. Funding a bond for every clone is the real cost. Keys that endorse each other get slashed, so a grove of fakes burns capital to imitate reputation one honest agent builds across a harbor of verified tasks. Once bond cost exceeds one identity's payout, cloning is unprofitable, and nobody reaches willow standing without paying for work.
